Name: Cuter wizard child
Author: AstaEckhart
Description:
Based on Who's wizard portraits style, a fitting portrait of the child is drawn!
English is not my mother tongue, please forgive me!

－－－－－－－
◆ How to use

Ｗizard Child Portrait
1. Download UniqueChildren Talk, this mod can provide portraits and conversations for your children!
2. Select the skin color you like, and then change the name of the portrait image file to your child's name
(Ex: Child name is Asa, then change the file name to Asa.png, Asa2.png...and so on, keep the number after the name, so that the child's portrait can match the clothing!)
3. Finish!
Path ▼
Mods\UniqueChildren Talk\assets\Portraits
－－－－－－－
Wizard Child Sprites
1. Download UniqueChildren, this mod can change your children into different clothes!
2. Choose one of my folders (Magnus or Wizard) to overwrite to the Magnus or Wizard folder, which one to overwrite depends on whether you play sve, if you have installed sve, overwrite the file to Magnus, of course, you can also cover both!
3. Finish!
Path ▼
Mods\UniqueChildren\assets\Adopted\Magnus or Wizard
Mods\UniqueChildren\assets\Natural\Magnus or Wizard

－－－－－－－
Wizard Child Hat

１.There are two Hair images in the folder, choose the version you want (the default is no hat), and name it Hair.png
２.Finish!

*Child portrait is in HD, he will need Portraiture or HD Portraits to work.

Portraiture version: 
You only need to place the child's portrait (named) in Portraiture, but Portraiture currently has a bug. It will only display the portrait of the first set of clothing and cannot display other clothing correctly.

HD Portraits version (you need to delete Portraiture to use this):
1. Download the sample package of optional files
2. Change the child name in content.json to your child’s name
3. Place the child's portrait into the corresponding folder in assets. The image file names only need to be named 1, 2, 3, and 4.
4. Put the sample package into Mods
5. Finish!!

－－－－－－－
◆ 如何使用

巫師孩子的肖像圖
１.下載UniqueChildren Talk，這個模組能為你的孩子提供肖像與對話！
２.選擇你喜歡的膚色，然後將肖像圖檔的名字改成你的孩子名字
（例：你的孩子叫Asa，那就將檔名改成Asa.png、Asa2.png....以此類推，名字後的數字要保留，這才能讓孩子的肖像與服裝匹配！）
３.完成！

－－－－－－－
巫師孩子的角色圖
１.下載UniqueChildren，這個模組能為你的孩子換上不同服裝！
２.選擇我其中一個文件夾（Magnus或Wizard）覆蓋到Magnus或Wizard文件夾，覆蓋哪個取決於你是否遊玩sve，如果你安裝了sve就將文件覆蓋到Magnus，當然，你也可以兩個都覆蓋！

－－－－－－－
巫師帽
１.文件夾中有兩張頭髮圖片，選擇自己想要的版本（默認是無帽子），命名為Hair.png
２.完成！

*孩子肖像是高清的，他會需要Portraiture或HD Portraits才能運作。

Portraiture版：
你只需將孩子的肖像（已命名）放置在Portraiture即可，但Portraiture目前有bug，他只會顯示第一套服裝的肖像，並不能正確顯示其他服裝。

HD Portraits版（使用這個需要刪除Portraiture）：
1.下載可選文件的示例包
2.將content.json裡的孩子名稱改為你的孩子名稱
3.將孩子肖像置入assets裡的對應文件夾，圖檔名稱只需命名為1、2、 3、 4。
4.將示例包放入Mods
5.完成!
